# FINMA Canada Inc.

> Senior-led boutique firm in Laval, Québec delivering integrated Corporate Finance, M&A Advisory and Property Management for Canadian SMBs and Syndicates of Co-ownership.

FINMA Canada Inc. has no affiliation with the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA). The site is bilingual (English at `/`, French at `/fr/`).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Firm overview, capabilities and credentials.
- [About](/about): Mission, identity and what sets FINMA apart.
- [Who We Are](/who-we-are): Team, standard of practice and differentiators.
- [Contact](/contact): Office, phone, email and consultation request form.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Client quotes and proof points.

## Services

- [Corporate Finance](/services/corporate-finance): Capital raising and financing strategy.
- [M&A Advisory](/services/ma-advisory): Sell-side and buy-side transaction advisory.
- [Financial Advisory](/financial-advisory): Strategic financial guidance for SMBs.
- [Property Management](/property-management): Full-service residential and commercial management.
- [Syndicate Management](/services/syndicate-management): Québec co-ownership syndicate management.
- [Our Approach](/services/our-approach): Fiduciary, integrated methodology.
- [TEKIS](/services/tekis): FINMA's operating framework (Trust, Expertise, Knowledge, Integrity, Strategy).
